notes: The exact SKU "3G-4K-TX" is not a literal Just Add Power model number; the closest and best-matching real product is the ULTRA Series UL-707POE (manufacturer part VBS-HDIP-707POE), marketed by JAP and resellers (e.g. BTX) as the "3G [POE] Transmitter 4K" / "3G Standard/High-Fidelity 4K Transmitter" — a 3G Ultra HD-over-IP HDMI encoder. Desktop/wall-mount enclosure (121 x 30 x 125 mm) — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. RS232 port is physically a 3.5mm TRS mini-jack (2-way/full-duplex serial), mapped to trs-3.5 as the closest connector id in the allowed list — it is a control/data serial port, not analog audio, so no grade was set (RS232 has no entry in the given bandwidth scales). No physical IR port exists on the unit itself; IR control is delivered via IR-over-IP and requires an external IRD2 dongle, so it was not listed as a port. No USB port is present. PoE (IEEE 802.3af, 15.4W drawn, up to 10W consumed) is available on the RJ-45 network port as an alternative to the local DC power jack; both are listed since the unit ships with a DC power supply and rear DC barrel jack in addition to PoE capability. Network grade set to eth-1g per the "1 Gb Network" rear panel label. HDMI grade set to hdmi-2.0 per documented "HDMI Standard: HDMI 2.0a" and HDCP 2.2 compliance.
